title: ABOUT THE AUTHOR
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Jerome K. Jerome (1859–1927) was an English novelist, humorist, short-story writer, actor, and playwright. Born in Staffordshire, England, Jerome’s political aspirations were curtailed when he lost both parents at early age. To support himself he abandoned his studies and took on a series of jobs from railway worker and actor, to school teacher and solicitor’s clerk. It was as a writer that Jerome found his footing. Over the next thirty years, he would pen satirical essays, short stories, more than twenty plays, an autobiography, and thirteen novels, including Three Men in A Boat which was greeted with instant success and which is still widely read today.
